value.rationale: The exact threshold distinguishes per-step contraction stability (up to twice inverse curvature) from instancewise one-epoch RR expected-error superiority (uniformly only through inverse curvature) in the smallest nontrivial finite sum. Equal curvature yields the same reversal for every initial point, so it is not an accidental initialization artifact. This calibrates interpreting recent worst-case rate guarantees without claiming a new long-run algorithmic rate.
